proposals.title: Fix the broken lint setup
proposals.body:
## Summary

Lint cannot start. `eslint.config.mjs` imports `eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals` and `eslint-config-next/typescript`, but the installed `eslint-config-next` is v15 while the app runs Next 16, and ESLint fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND before checking any file.

## Key Decisions

- Align `eslint-config-next` with the installed Next major version rather than rewriting the config by hand.

## Implementation

- Bump `eslint-config-next` in `package.json` to the version matching `next`.
- Confirm `npx eslint` runs on `app/` and `.devcontainer/codeyam-preview-origin.test.ts`, then fix any findings.
proposals.reason: Lint still cannot run, so no lint check guards the new race pages

proposals.title: Relative seed token @today+Nh silently drops the hours
proposals.body:
## What happened
SCENARIO_FIXTURE_DATE_DRIFT told me to use `@today+2h`-style tokens. `@today+377h` expanded to `2026-11-11T00:00:00Z` (date-truncated), so a noon-ET deadline became 7 pm the previous evening and race days could shift a day in ET. No docs describe the difference between @now, @today and @date; I found it by checking the seeded API output and switched to `@now+Nh`.

## What would have helped
Document the three tokens' semantics in the audit note and register help, and warn when an hour/minute offset is combined with a date-truncating token.
proposals.reason: @today+377h expanded to a midnight date, shifting deadline times and race days

proposals.title: github-setup unusable in Codespaces because GITHUB_TOKEN shadows a real login
proposals.body:
## What happened
commit-state reported no-remote-gh-unauthed while `gh auth status` showed logged in via GITHUB_TOKEN. The push step only offered the manual github.com/new path. I had to run `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh auth login --web` in the shared terminal and then `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN codeyam-editor editor github-setup`. The user asked why it could not just sign in for them.

## What would have helped
In Codespaces, have github-setup drive the device-flow login itself (in the shared terminal) and ignore the codespace GITHUB_TOKEN for repo creation.
proposals.reason: gh looks signed in via the codespace token, which cannot create repos; needed env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh auth login

proposals.title: stage-feature --path replaces earlier staging, so the commit lost the app source
proposals.body:
## What happened
After the pre-commit lockfile check failed I ran `stage-feature --path .nvmrc --path README.md`. It reset the index to only those paths plus .codeyam/, listing the whole app as untouchedExternal, and the commit succeeded with no app code. I caught it from `git show --stat` and amended.

## What would have helped
Make stage-feature additive to what is already staged, or refuse to commit when untouchedExternal contains files the full-finalize marker validated.
proposals.reason: A second stage-feature --path call unstaged 68 app files; the commit went through without them

proposals.title: Scenario sandbox database emptied after a test run
proposals.body:
## What happened
After `refresh-tests --file …` the capture DB (.codeyam/tmp/db-sandbox/capture.db) had 0 rows, so the page rendered the empty state. `preview` with a scenarioSlug did not re-seed it; only `register` did. Also, the first register ran while the dev server was still down and saved a scenario whose seed never landed.

## What would have helped
Have `preview {scenarioSlug}` re-apply the seed when the sandbox is empty, and have register wait for the dev server before seeding.
proposals.reason: Preview rendered 0 races until the scenario was re-registered

proposals.title: Commit-step lint gate needs a file edit that the commit step forbids

## What happened
The pre-commit hook blocked on lockfile-sync ('add a .nvmrc'), first reported only at Commit. Creating .nvmrc via shell worked, but editing README to match was refused because slug=commit allows no code changes.

## What would have helped
Run lockfile-sync in verify-build earlier (it skipped as 'no matching files' for untracked files), so the gap surfaces while edits are still allowed.
proposals.reason: lockfile-sync required .nvmrc at commit time; the matching README edit was then refused

## What happened

After the editor server reloaded (preview-origin-mode and later reload-config), the Build tab showed "The build agent is taking longer than usual — hasn't accepted its first instruction yet" while the one agent session (pty-broker list: one attached session) was busy mid-turn. The user saw it twice and asked to remove it. No CLI command dismisses it; the only options were reloading the tab or respawning the agent, which would have killed the work.

## What would have helped

Treat a reattached session that is mid-turn (activity: agent turn in flight) as accepted, or offer a dismiss command / close button that the agent can trigger.

proposals.title: Editor terminal pane won't copy text with Ctrl+C
proposals.body:
## What happened
The user tried to copy a GitHub link Claude printed in the editor's left terminal pane (the browser terminal over /ws/terminal, Claude Code 2.1.311 running full-screen) and could not. Ctrl+C copied nothing. The pane's key handler copies only when xterm has a selection, and Claude Code's full-screen TUI appears to take mouse events, so dragging never makes a selection (inferred, not measured). Nothing on screen explains Shift+drag or the right-click Copy menu. Claude had to render the link in a Live Preview page with a Copy button. While trying, the user also ran /clear by accident. A full report is on the debug/preview-report branch as debug/terminal-copy-report.md.

## What would have helped
A reliable copy path in the terminal pane: a one-time hint about Shift+drag when mouse tracking is on, clickable/copyable URLs (web-links addon), and a short note when Ctrl+C reaches the terminal with nothing selected.
proposals.reason: The user could not copy a branch link from the terminal and had to ask for it on a preview page.

proposals.title: Blank isolated-component capture accepted as a successful register
proposals.body:
## What happened
A menu component positioned with `position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 6px)` rendered off-screen on its own isolation page (no positioned parent). `register` captured three fully blank screenshots and reported `captured=3 ... success: true`, with no blank-frame warning. Only opening the PNGs showed it. `recapture-stale` after a CSS fix then reported `recaptured: 0`, so the blank frames stayed until the scenarios were re-registered by hand.

## What would have helped
`register` (and `recapture-stale`) flagging a capture with no visible content inside `#codeyam-capture`, and a CSS change that affects a scenario marking its screenshot stale.
proposals.reason: Three new component screenshots were blank and register still reported success.

proposals.title: Committing to another branch from a worktree needs a second editor server
proposals.body:
## What happened
The user asked to add a markdown report to an existing debug branch. Plain `git commit` was refused by the step-slug hook, so the work went through `editor commit --out-of-workflow` from a git worktree. That failed until 34 files were classified for the test cache, then needed `refresh-tests`, which needed an editor server for the worktree: `project-scan` to register it, then `start` failing on port 14859 (already used by the main editor), then `config-override` on two ports, then the test run, then cleanup and `project-forget`.

## What would have helped
A documented, lightweight way to commit a docs-only change on a side branch (or to run `refresh-tests` for a worktree through the already-running editor) without registering and booting a second project.
proposals.reason: Adding a text report to a debug branch took a project registration, a temporary server with port overrides, and a test refresh.

## What would have helped
A `browserState` example in `register --help` and `docs/scenarios.md`, plus `scenario-explain` listing the seeded keys.

proposals.title: Push refuses the feature commit even though session-finalize passed just before it was made
proposals.body:
## What happened
session-finalize ran at the Finalize step and passed (152/152 tests). The Commit step then created f641016. At the Push step, `codeyam-editor editor push` exited 1 with "Refusing to push: 1 source commit(s) after the last finalize carry no deferred trailer and are not yet finalized", naming f641016. Re-running `session-finalize` reused every cached partition and passed in ~20s, after which push succeeded. The tree was identical to the one finalize had validated.

## What would have helped
Record the finalize verdict against the tree hash (or have `commit` stamp the resulting commit as covered when its tree matches the last finalized tree), so the in-workflow Finalize → Commit → Push sequence never trips the un-finalized-commit guard.
proposals.reason: Push blocked a freshly finalized commit and forced a second session-finalize run

proposals.title: Follow a race until its registration opening date is announced
proposals.body:
## Who benefits
Runners planning their season who want to enter a race the moment registration opens, especially popular races that sell out.

## Evidence
- obs-d57f8bac499d (More ways to sort the race list): only 4 seeded races had a registration-opens date, so sorting by opening date left most races grouped at the end.
- obs-352015877879 (Real registration-opening dates for every race): after researching every race, 17 of 24 organizers still had not published an opening date, so a runner still can't tell when to be ready.

## Smallest useful version
On a saved race with no announced opening date, show "Opening date not announced yet", plus what is known (for example, last year's opening date as a labelled hint). Show a "newly announced" badge in My Races when a date appears after the race was saved. This reuses the existing "changed since you saved" notice.

## Case against
It overlaps the deferred Reminders deliverable, which would notify rather than show a badge. Its value depends on someone rechecking organizer sites often enough to catch announcements, and today there is no automated refresh. Last year's date as a hint could mislead if organizers change their schedule.
proposals.reason: Most races still have no announced registration opening date, so runners planning ahead can't tell when to be ready.

proposals.title: Stored race prices have drifted from organizer pages
proposals.body:
## Root cause
Race data is a hand-verified snapshot in prisma/race-data.json. Organizers changed their price tiers after the last check, and nothing re-verifies or flags the stored schedule, so the race pages keep showing the old tiers as current.

## Evidence
fnd-b945703ca96b (wrong-result) and fnd-c7f5b6fc4daa. On HEAD 5eade58 the stale values are still stored: prisma/race-data.json:980 (Brooklyn Experience Half, 'Rises to $165', tier date 2026-10-28; the site shows Dec 17 / Jan 27), prisma/race-data.json:1133 (Jersey City Marathon, '$200 to $225 after Dec 31'; the site shows $220 to $225 after Nov 30), prisma/race-data.json:1142 (Jersey City Half, '$150 to $180 after Dec 31'; the site shows $175 to $180 after Nov 30).

## Smallest fix
Update those three price schedules from the organizer pages and bump their lastVerifiedAt.

## Cost of leaving it
Runners see wrong prices and wrong price-rise deadlines. The Jersey City increases happen a month earlier than shown, so someone waiting for the 'Dec 31' deadline pays more.
proposals.reason: Three race pages show price schedules that no longer match the organizers' sites.

proposals.title: Blank screenshots slip past capture checks
proposals.body:
## Root cause
The capture pipeline's blank-page judgement does not reliably detect what is actually painted. Blank isolated-component frames passed register as successful, and a photo drawn as a CSS background was reported as blank. The check looks at the wrong signal (DOM/content heuristics rather than rendered pixels).

## Evidence
fnd-4470fa0930a2: three new component screenshots were blank and register still reported success. fnd-7f5a2660203f: a photo thumbnail drawn as a CSS background was reported as a blank page. Not verified against codeyam-editor source, which is not in this repository.

## Smallest fix
Base the blank check on the rendered screenshot's pixel variance, so a capture is judged blank only when its pixels are uniform.

## Cost of leaving it
Blank captures get committed as evidence (a false green), and valid captures get flagged, wasting investigation time.
proposals.reason: Blank captures are accepted as successes, and real images can be called blank.

proposals.title: Scenario time and seed state gets lost or mangled
proposals.body:
## Root cause
Scenario state that should persist across operations (the pinned clock, relative-time tokens, the sandbox database) is rebuilt or rewritten by operations that should leave it alone: token expansion truncates to a date, re-registration replaces the whole scenario including its clock block, and a test run resets the sandbox database.

## Evidence
fnd-977c38d5479a: @today+377h expanded to a midnight date, shifting deadline times. fnd-b55899033c8a: re-registering a scenario to refresh its seed dropped its pinned clock, surfacing only at reconcile as 31 date-drift findings. fnd-1fe8c89b915d: the preview rendered 0 races after a test run until the scenario was re-registered. Not verified against codeyam-editor source, which is not in this repository.

## Smallest fix
Have register merge into an existing scenario, keeping fields the payload omits (clock in particular), and keep hours in relative-time expansion.

## Cost of leaving it
Scenarios silently render the wrong time or empty data, which is found late at reconcile and fixed by hand.
